notes.title: Glintland Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to share that the [i]Glintland[/i] demo is now officially available to play![/p][p][/p][p]During Automation Fest, many of you discovered our relaxing, magical tile-placement game — and we received wonderful feedback. 
The green [b]Download Demo[/b] button is now active on the main store page for everyone![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t tried it yet, now’s the perfect moment to jump into Glintland and build your own cozy factory world.[/p][p]Thanks for your support, and happy building![/p][p][/p][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts in a store review! [i]Glintland[/i] is still in development, and your feedback really helps us make it even better.[/p][p][/p][p]— Kris from itengy games[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1 – Light Up a New Glint
notes.content:
[p][b]Light Up a New Glint[/b][/p][list][*][p]"Start Settlement" is now [b]"Start Glint"[/b]!
The term [i]Glint[/i] better reflects the short-lived, magical nature of each step in your journey like a flicker of light in a darkening world.[/p][/*][/list][p]📜 [b]New Descriptions Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]You'll now find descriptions for [b]Quests[/b], [b]Favors[/b], and [b]Tavern Trials[/b] in the game UI![/p][/*][/list][p]✨ [b]What’s a Glint?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each deck you play through is called a Glint (a short, magical step on your journey).[/p][/*][*][p]Your settlement begins anew each time, but your [b]knowledge[/b], [b]favors[/b], and [b]level[/b] persist.[/p][/*][*][p]The more light you collect, the faster you’ll level up and expand your deck.[/p][/*][/list][p]🐞 [b]Fixes & Feedback[/b][/p][list][*][p]We hear you — and we’ve already addressed a few issues from your feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]This patch includes [b]small bug fixes[/b] and [b]localization improvements[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Want to contribute more? Join our Discord Server: [url="https://discord.gg/AYNhSecwxP"]https://discord.gg/AYNhSecwxP[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and lighting up Glintland! 💡[/p]

notes.title: DEMO DROPS JULY 14th 2025
notes.content:
[p][b]The Glintland Demo arrives on July 14![/b][/p][p]Get ready to explore a magical world of card-driven building, relaxing vibes, and satisfying factory gameplay.[/p][p]🎮 Controller & Steam Deck support
🧙‍♀️ You're the architect of a mystical settlement
📦 Produce, combine, and fulfill magical quests[/p][p]Play the first missions and help shape the game with your feedback.
Wishlist [i]Glintland[/i] now and don't miss the demo drop![/p]

notes.title: Glintland at LEVEL UP Salzburg
notes.content:
[h3]When & Where:[/h3][p]June 28–29, 2025, starting at 10:00 AM each day
Messezentrum Salzburg – Indie Area, organized by FH Salzburg[/p][p][/p][h3]What to expect:[/h3][p]Join us in the vibrant [b]Indie Games Area[/b] with over 40 indie booths and discover [i]Glintland[/i] up close. Play the latest version of the game, give feedback directly to the devs, and chat about the inspirations behind its charming mix of calm strategy and puzzle factory building.[/p][p][/p][h3]Live Streams & EDU Zone:[/h3][p]Popular streamers will be broadcasting directly from the Indie Area, and you can explore the educational zone featuring hands-on demos of game engines, 3D printing, and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]Why Glintland belongs here:[/h3][p][i]Glintland[/i] fits right into this creative festival environment — a game for dreamers and tinkerers alike. It’s cozy, clever, and crafted with love. LEVEL UP brings together gamers, families, streamers, and developers, making it the perfect place to showcase this unique indie experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Visitor Highlights:[/h3][p]– [b]Play live[/b]: Try [i]Glintland[/i] at the booth and share your feedback
– [b]Meet the devs[/b]: Talk directly with the creators
– [b]Streamer spotlight[/b]: Watch or join live coverage from the Indie Area
– [b]Community & networking[/b]: Connect with fans, developers, and indie enthusiasts[/p]

notes.title: GLINTLAND @ LIWEST LOVES GAMES MADE IN AUSTRIA
notes.content:
Bei diesem Event in Kooperation mit dem last by Schachermayer kannst du Glintland gratis zocken und die Entwickler dahinter treffen.

[h1]PROGRAMM[/h1]

[b]16:00 – 17:30 Uhr [/b]| Erdgeschoss im last dance
Vorstellung: Begrüßung Stefan Gintenreiter (Geschäftsführer LIWEST), anschließend Präsentation der österreichischen Videospiele von den jeweiligen Entwickler*innen

[b]17:30 – 18:00 Uhr[/b] | Erdgeschoss im last slice
Pause: Pizza & Getränke 

[b]18:00 – 22:00 Uhr[/b] | 1. Stock im last games
Zocken: Entwickler präsentieren ihre Games auf den verschiedenen Stationen

[h2]Tickets and Organizer[/h2]
[url=https://www.liwest.at/loves-games-made-in-austria]Event Homepage: LIWEST - Love Games Made in Austria[/url]

Jede Person, die einen garantierten Sitzplatz bei der Vorstellung von 16:00 bis 17:30 Uhr haben möchte, sollte sich ein Gratis-Ticket sichern. Pro Ticket kann nur eine Person gebucht werden.
Im last dance stehne nur eine begrenzte Anzahl an Sitzplätzen sowie Stehplätze ohne Ticket zur Verfügung.
